title: Coordinate conjugation of the constructed ordinary tensor comparison
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, b a tower base, f:X to Y a scheme morphism, and g a Geometry for f [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. Let B' and tau' be target coefficient sheaves and transitions identified with the canonical ones, and F the system pullback identified with g.pull. For each source system N let mu(N) be a natural isomorphism tensorRight(N) followed by F to F followed by tensorRight(FN), using the canonical monoidal sheaf tensors. Then comparisonOfCoordinates(g,B',tau',F,mu) at M,N [def-sfb-tower-class-tensor-comparison] is heterogeneously equal to F of the source siteTensorIso.hom at M, followed by mu(N).hom at M, followed by the target siteTensorIso.inv at FM. All supplied coefficient, transition and functor identifications are retained.

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: Eliminate the coefficient equality, then the heterogeneous transition equality, then the pull-functor equality. The two sides are now definitionally the composite defining comparisonOfCoordinates. The private transport_pure helper similarly eliminates these coordinates and substitutes the three unit-section identifications in a fixed pure-tensor equality, retaining the actual sectionAdjoint and tensorPure definitions.

theorem tensorComparison_coordinates {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E}
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (B' : ℕ → Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (τ' : ∀ n, B' (n + 1) ⟶ B' n)
    (hB : B' = SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (hτ : HEq τ' (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X))
    (F : SpTowerShriek.S l E Y ⥤ SemilinearSections.Systems.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) B' τ') (hF : HEq g.pull F)
    (μ : ∀ N : SpTowerShriek.S l E Y,
      let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients
        (SemilinearSections.systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
          (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E Y))
      let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory
        (SemilinearSections.systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
          (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E Y))
      let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients
        (SemilinearSections.systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) B' τ')
      let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory
        (SemilinearSections.systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) B' τ')
      CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorRight N ⋙ F ≅
        F ⋙ CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorRight (F.obj N))
    (M N : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)) :
    HEq ((comparisonOfCoordinates l E g B' τ' hB hτ F hF μ N).hom.app M)
      (F.map ((siteTensorIso.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)) (systemRing l E Y) N).hom.app
            M) ≫ (μ N).hom.app M ≫
        (siteTensorIso.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
          (SemilinearSections.systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) B' τ')
          (F.obj N)).inv.app (F.obj M))
